title: Initiate WebAssembly logout through supported navigation
goal: Replace legacy sign-out session setup with NavigateToLogout when migrating a browser-hosted remote authentication app, preserving provider logout, callback and local return navigation.

selectionNotes: NavigateToLogout already works on .NET 10; .NET 11 removes SignOutSessionStateManager.
Both reject invalid non-null history. With null history .NET 10 checks session storage; RC2 accepts the request without that fallback.
Requires browser-hosted WASM, the framework auth route and a registered provider; not server cookie logout or authorization enforcement.

packageAssets: Current lib/net11.0 WASM Authentication plus matching authentication JS and browser runtime; comparison uses actual matching net10.0 assets. Locked exact resolved package sets are retained beside each sample.
providers: Already registered OIDC provider with code/PKCE, RP-initiated logout and exact login/logout callback URIs. Authoring proof: one loopback oidc-provider 9.5.1 with a fixed fictional account and in-memory signing/session state.
platforms: Modern WebAssembly browser with history/session storage; verified Windows x64 / Chromium. No optional native SDK/workload or AOT/relinking claim.
renderingModes: Browser-hosted interactive WebAssembly only; no static SSR or Interactive Server authentication claim.
prerequisites: Register AddOidcAuthentication; load matching AuthenticationService.js before Blazor; map authentication/{Action} to RemoteAuthenticatorView.
Register the exact /authentication/login-callback and /authentication/logout-callback origins at the provider, and the public /permits return route.
Loopback HTTP/fixed identity are authoring-only; real deployments need the provider's HTTPS/account/session/redirect policies.

stabilityLimitations: Stable supported replacements already available in .NET 10; current evidence is .NET 11 RC2, with GA reconciliation pending.
